title: Goodfellas
events_chronological: As a boy in Brooklyn, Henry Hill parks cars for the crew across the street and decides that being a gangster beats being president.
Henry is arrested for selling stolen cigarettes and comes out of court to find the whole crew waiting to congratulate him for saying nothing.
Henry, Jimmy Conway and Tommy DeVito hijack lorries out of the airport and sell the loads on.
Henry meets Karen, and when a neighbour assaults her he pistol-whips the man on his own drive and hands Karen the gun to hide.
Henry and Karen marry, and Karen learns to live with the money, the absences and the other men's wives.
Tommy stabs and shoots a made man, Billy Batts, in Henry's club, and the three of them drive the body upstate to bury it.
Six months on they have to dig Batts up again because the land has been sold.
Henry sets up a mistress in an apartment, and Karen finds out and holds a revolver to his face while he sleeps.
Jimmy and Henry burn down a restaurant they have emptied through a paper credit line.
Henry is jailed for beating a gambler who complained to his sister, and runs a food and drugs business from inside.
Henry comes out and starts dealing heroin against Paulie's express orders, pulling in Karen, Tommy and Jimmy.
The crew take six million dollars out of the airport cargo terminal in a single night.
Jimmy has almost everyone involved in the robbery killed as they start spending the money where it can be seen.
Tommy is told he is to be made and is shot through the head instead, in payment for Batts.
On one frantic day Henry runs drugs, cooks a family dinner and is followed by a helicopter, and is arrested that evening.
Paulie gives Henry a few thousand dollars and disowns him, and Jimmy tries to send him and Karen to a killing in Florida.
Henry testifies against Paulie and Jimmy and enters witness protection, ending up an ordinary man collecting his newspaper in a suburb.
syuzhet_notes: The film opens with the three men stopping the car to finish off the man in the boot, then cuts to the narrator's line about always having wanted to be a gangster and starts again thirty years earlier. It reaches that opening scene again at told-order bullet 8. Nothing else is out of order.
fabula_notes: The narration is retrospective throughout, but it is voice-over rather than a separate scene level, so the boot scene is a flash-forward rather than a frame the rest is told from.
